title: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.11
content: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.11 is now available.
The updater now waits for the old launcher process to fully exit before starting MSI installation.
The launcher restarts only after Windows Installer reports a successful update.
Update retries refresh the latest trusted installer URL and SHA-256 metadata.
Click Update Now below to securely download, verify, and install the new build.
